included.goal: Replace external chacha20poly1305 in crates/susi-vendor-chacha20poly1305 with a pure-Rust #![forbid(unsafe_code)] RFC 8439 ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD implementation using constant-time ARX ChaCha20, 5x26-bit limb Poly1305 MAC, subtle::ConstantTimeEq 16-byte tag verification prior to decryption, and zeroize::Zeroize key/OTK/keystream clearing. Removes 8 packages from Cargo.lock (aead, chacha20, chacha20poly1305, cipher, inout, opaque-debug, poly1305, universal-hash; Cargo.lock 193 -> 185; 170 cumulative Cargo.lock packages removed across T-CARBONLEAN-1..15) and lowers THIRD_PARTY_CEILING 107 -> 99 (crossing under 100 third-party crates across the four pillars from the 331 baseline).
included.title: Lean core: replace external chacha20poly1305 with #![forbid(unsafe_code)] RFC 8439 ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD (THIRD_PARTY_CEILING 107 -> 99, Cargo.lock 193 -> 185)
